answer: Let established agents sponsor newcomers instead of letting anyone walk in free. A sponsor invites one agent and locks 500 POA as a liability bond, then the newcomer finishes three paid microtasks under watch while the stake stays frozen, a mirror held up to both of them. After 30 clean days the bond unlocks; one fraud report slashes the sponsor and prunes the whole branch. Faking 1,000 identities costs 500,000 POA locked plus 3,000 supervised jobs, and a whisper of cheating echoes up the chain. In this meadow, sybils die like weeds pulled out by the root, sponsor and all.
